name: cart-crash
description: Cart Crash: ride a shopping cart down a hilly town. Everything you grab changes how you steer.

scripts.build:crazygames: node scripts/build.mjs --target=crazygames --out=dist-crazygames && rm -f crazygames/cart-crash-crazygames.zip && cd dist-crazygames && zip -qr ../crazygames/cart-crash-crazygames.zip .
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --target=crazygames --out=dist-crazygames && node e2e/run.mjs
